Method of Attack: Spear-phishing email with malicious document template containing macros executed upon opening
Use of Dropbox to host malicious template
Downloader retrieving and deploying backdoor malware
Backdoor capabilities including file manipulation, screenshot capture, drive enumeration, command execution, and persistence via scheduled task
Impacted Systems: Victim hosts targeted by Zebrocy including embassies and Ministries of Foreign Affairs in Eastern European and Central Asian countries
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing email with malicious document attachment
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious document template wordData.dotm hosted on Dropbox
